channel.title: Found First Research
channel.description: Original studies on the questions people ask businesses, with findings and source data.

item.title: How often do West Michigan thunderstorm wind reports mention trees?
item.description: In Kent, Ionia and Montcalm counties, 48 of 64 NOAA thunderstorm wind event reports mentioned a tree or trees during 2021 through 2025.

item.title: Does a HELOC always come second? Michigan’s mortgage records give an answer.
item.description: Of 46,741 qualifying Michigan home equity lines originated in 2025, 12,539 were recorded in first lien position. See the counts by loan purpose.

item.title: Can you catch the airport shuttle at 12:30 a.m.?
item.description: Found First reviewed 12 hotels across three airports. Eleven advertised a shuttle. Five published hours that answered a late-arriving guest’s question.

item.title: Same business. Different answer.
